staleWhen: Caption painting no longer follows the asynchronous ActualThemeChanged event.
effects: Changes test synchronization; does not change application painting.

guidance.do: Wait with a deadline for all four expected caption colors before asserting them.
guidance.avoid: Do not treat a fixed delay after RequestedTheme changes as proof that caption painting finished.
guidance.recognize: The caption assertion sees the previous theme while other theme resources already match.
guidance.why: ActualThemeChanged can arrive on a later tick. Keep wrong-color mutation controls so waiting does not weaken the assertion.

evidence.diagnosis: The caption assertion ran before the theme event painted the buttons, not during high contrast; the investigation for https://github.com/danswett/agent-bridge/issues/424 is recorded in PR 430.
